item.description: One awards night, watched across 200 countries by over 120 million viewers. Broadcast on over 18 channels and one streaming platform. Spread across three months. item.title: Agami Realty appoints Sunil Gavaskar as brand ambassador
item.description: Agami Realty has announced the appointment of former Indian cricketer Sunil Gavaskar as its brand ambassador. item.title: ICICI Lombard marks 25 years with new brand campaign
item.description: ICICI Lombard has launched a new brand campaign titled ‘25 Years of keeping promises’ to mark 25 years of operations in India’s general insurance market. The campaign reflects on the company’s journey and its relationship with customers, partners and stakeholders over the past two and a half decades.
